attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 2
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 2
defer myagang-care-home elderly 1
</plan>
COST: 102

Notes:
- The six injured at Dhunche temple are carried in two trips of 4 and 2, both on the 13-minute Shivapuri–Dhunche road. Dhunche is not a designated evacuation point, so they are unloaded at Shivapuri shelter.
- The Myagang care home has no usable road. Its only link, the Likhu market bridge, was washed away, so the elderly widow is deferred to a later wave (penalty 50).
- The Shivapuri–Likhu road is excluded because floodwater is running fast over it and a truck was swept off it. If that road is confirmed passable, it would not change this plan, since no one is waiting at Likhu market.
- The Galchhi school road is not needed, and no one is waiting there.
